pi_reduce_design.summary: G3 and G4 converge. packages/demo/src/pi.ts exists to 'project a partial into the partial shape the fabric's one combiner accepts' — pi IS a reduce workload. Colouring cannot demonstrate a verified reduce because it is first-found-wins, which is why answerOf is correct for it. Wiring pi as a second demo workload whose merge goes through reduceJob closes G4 (the workload) AND G3 (the verified tree-reduce), and moves the demo half of MR-03..MR-07 off Partial.
pi_reduce_design.shape: submit pi shards (same input block, partitioned) -> reduceJob(result.job, {rpc: node.rpc, executors: peerIds, blockstore: node.store, project: projectPiPartial, trustedIssuers}) -> estimatePi(scaledTotal) checked against piErrorBound(terms).
pi_reduce_design.blocker_1_trust_root: THERE IS NO SIGNED RECORD FOR THE PI KERNEL, and this is the hard part. packages/demo/src/kernel-record.ts is GENERATED and states that sign-kernel.ts 'generates a new ed25519 key on every run and discards the private half immediately'. There is exactly one anchor. bin/agent.ts and bin/seed.ts BOTH default to KERNEL_TRUST_ANCHOR, so a pi record signed by any other key is refused by a stock agent. Adding pi therefore means extending sign-kernel.ts to sign BOTH kernels under one new key and committing the new anchor plus both records TOGETHER — a change to the demo's trust root that alters what every stock node will run. NEEDS EXPLICIT OWNER SIGN-OFF before anyone builds it.
pi_reduce_design.blocker_2_solo_visitor: reduce-job.ts:385 returns {ok:false, reason:'no executor to combine on'} when executors is empty, and ReduceJobOptions says 'the submitter is NOT among them'. So a lone visitor cannot run the reduce at all. This is clean and the panel should render the named reason — but it means the milestone's headline claim only renders when a second device is present. runColouring's analogous answer is onQuorumShortfall:'runs-at-available-redundancy'; the reduce path has no such degradation.
pi_reduce_design.note: G13's egress panel already reads whichever manifest it is handed, so this work makes its WITHHELD branch live with no change to that code.
